title: PHMForge: Evaluating LLM Agents on Industrial Prognostics through MCP-Native, Algorithm-Grounded Tools
abstract: arXiv:2604.01532v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents are beginning to invoke industrial asset-management tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), yet whether they can act reliably on this substrate for safety-critical \emph{Prognostics and Health Management (PHM)} is unanswered. Prior benchmarks conflate protocol fluency with reasoning, instrumentation failures with agent failures, and tool use with tool retrieval. We introduce \textbf{PHMForge}, an evaluation environment that closes each conflation. PHMForge ships 99 SME-authored scenarios across eight industrial asset classes spanning rotating equipment, aero-engines, and lithium-ion cells, on public datasets including NASA PCoE, served through 39 MCP-native tools wrapping published PHM algorithms (C-MAPSS, ISO~10816, Arrhenius capacity-fade models, time-series foundation models). translated_title: PHMForge：通过MCP原生、算法支撑的工具评估工业预测性维护中的LLM代理
translated_abstract: 摘要：LLM代理开始通过模型上下文协议（MCP）调用工业资产管理工具，但它们在安全关键的“预测与健康管理（PHM）”中能否可靠地在此基座上运行，仍是一个未解问题。以往的基准测试将协议流畅性与推理能力混为一谈，将工具故障与代理故障混淆，并将工具使用与工具检索等同。我们引入了**PHMForge**，一个评估环境，旨在消除这些混淆。PHMForge提供了99个由领域专家编写的场景，涵盖八个工业资产类别，包括旋转设备、航空发动机和锂离子电池，基于公共数据集如NASA PCoE，并通过39个MCP原生工具提供，这些工具封装了已发表的PHM算法（如C-MAPSS、ISO 10816、阿伦尼乌斯容量衰减模型、时间序列基础模型）。在30个分层抽样的旋转设备/航空发动机场景中，Krippendorff's α系数在[0.74, 0.82]范围内；电池扩展部分仍在开发中。
tldr: PHMForge通过提供包含99个专家场景和39个MCP原生工具的评估环境，解决了LLM代理在工业预测性维护中评估时的协议、推理、工具和检索混淆问题，从而可靠地评估其安全性。
en_tdlr: PHMForge addresses the conflation of protocol fluency, reasoning, tool use, and retrieval in evaluating LLM agents for industrial prognostics by providing an environment with 99 expert scenarios and 39 MCP-native tools, enabling reliable safety-critical assessment.
